chunks: So you wait. They are also waiting.
ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'So you wait, they are waiting' mean in the context of Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *tawqee'* (divine timing), reminding the Prophet and believers that while they await God's decisive judgment, the disbelievers are anxiously anticipating the same retribution. It serves as a spiritual anchor during periods of delay, contrasting the patient expectation of the faithful with the fearful anticipation of the arrogant. This mutual waiting highlights the inevitability of divine justice, a core theme in the narrative of the prophets.
